name: jstack-evidence-builder
description: Top-level JStack command for prompt-compiled private screenshot and URL reference bundles before UI implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Private screenshot and URL reference bundles
interface.longDescription: Builds a private, digest-bound Product Interface reference bundle from user-provided screenshots, Figma exports, and explicitly approved URL captures. It can create up to two isolated standalone visual prototypes, records rights, redaction, and provider disclosures, and returns a receipt that may inform a later UI contract without counting as candidate QA evidence.
defaultPrompt: Build a private UI reference bundle from my approved screenshots or URLs before implementation.
